newsitem.title: UK: UK clears Newsquest buys from Pearson.
newsitem.headline: UK clears Newsquest buys from Pearson.

text.p: Britain said on Thursday it would allow the acquisition of the business and assets of Westminster Press from Pearson Plc by venture capital-backed Newsquest Media, following an investigation by the Monopolies and Mergers Commission (MMC).
A statement from the Department of Trade and Industry said the MMC report concluded the deal "was not expected to operate against the public interest" at national, regional or local level.
Through the acquisition, Newsquest will become one of the three largest publishers of regional and local newspapers in the UK, the MMC said, each having between 11 and 12 percent of the market.
In addition to competition concerns, the MMC said it had also considered financial issues in detail and noted that the enlarged Newsquest would have a high level of gearing.
"(The MMC) attaches importance to the commitments made by Newsquest and its financial backers to making substantial investments to build up the longer term value of the company," the statement added.
The company's backers include KKR of the U.S. and British venture capital specialists Cinven.
